skills.description: Use when operating, debugging or upgrading a Reliaburger cluster, or when you suspect a bug in Reliaburger itself. Reliaburger is a container orchestrator in one binary. Its CLI, `relish`, has a family of commands built for LLM agents, `relish agent`: each prints one line of JSON, never prompts and stays within a byte budget, and `relish agent source` reads the exact source the binary was built from.
skills.name: reliaburger
